title: एकत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira says that the Pandavas are ready for peace or for war, but as a last offer he will be content with just five villages, Kushasthala, Vrikasthala, Makandi, Varanavata and one more of Duryodhana's choosing, one for each brother, so that the family may live in peace.
summary.kn: ಪಾಂಡವರು ಶಾಂತಿಗೂ ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೂ ಸಿದ್ಧರು, ಆದರೆ ಕೊನೆಯ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾಪವಾಗಿ ಕುಲವು ಶಾಂತಿಯಿಂದ ಬದುಕಲು ಸಹೋದರರಿಗೆ ಒಂದೊಂದರಂತೆ ಕುಶಸ್ಥಲ, ವೃಕಸ್ಥಲ, ಮಾಕಂದೀ, ವಾರಣಾವತ ಮತ್ತು ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನು ಆರಿಸುವ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು, ಹೀಗೆ ಐದು ಗ್ರಾಮಗಳೇ ಸಾಕು ಎಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर कहते हैं कि पाण्डव शान्ति या युद्ध दोनों के लिए तैयार हैं, पर अन्तिम प्रस्ताव के रूप में वे केवल पाँच गाँवों से सन्तुष्ट होंगे, कुशस्थल, वृकस्थल, माकन्दी, वारणावत और एक दुर्योधन की पसन्द का, प्रत्येक भाई के लिए एक, ताकि कुल शान्ति से रह सके।
summary.te: పాండవులు శాంతికీ యుద్ధానికీ సిద్ధమని, కానీ చివరి ప్రతిపాదనగా కుటుంబం శాంతిగా జీవించడానికి ఒక్కో సోదరునికి ఒక్కటి చొప్పున కుశస్థలం, వృకస్థలం, మాకందీ, వారణావతం, దుర్యోధనుడు ఎంచుకునే మరొకటి, ఈ ఐదు గ్రామాలు చాలని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అంటాడు.
summary.ta: பாண்டவர்கள் அமைதிக்கும் போருக்கும் தயார், ஆனால் இறுதி வேண்டுகோளாகக் குடும்பம் அமைதியாக வாழ, சகோதரருக்கு ஒன்றாக குஶஸ்தலம், வ்ருகஸ்தலம், மாகந்தீ, வாரணாவதம், துரியோதனன் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கும் இன்னொன்று என ஐந்து கிராமங்களே போதும் என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் சொல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: പാണ്ഡവർ സമാധാനത്തിനോ യുദ്ധത്തിനോ തയ്യാറാണെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ പറയുന്നു; അവസാന വാഗ്ദാനമായി, കുടുംബം സമാധാനത്തോടെ ജീവിക്കാൻ, കുശസ്ഥലം, വൃകസ്ഥലം, മകന്ദി, വാരണാവതം, ദുര്യോധനൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്ന മറ്റൊരു ഗ്രാമം എന്നിങ്ങനെ അഞ്ചു ഗ്രാമങ്ങൾ മാത്രം മതിയെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു; ഓരോ സഹോദരനും ഓരോ ഗ്രാമം.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.31; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
उत सन्तमसन्तं च बालं वृद्धं च संजय ।
उताबलं बलीयांसं धाता प्रकुरुते वशे ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, whether a man is good or bad, a child or old, weak or strong, the Creator brings him under his sway.

verses.text:
उत बालाय पाण्डित्यं पण्डितायोत बालताम् ।
ददाति सर्वमीशानः पुरस्ताच्छुक्रमुच्चरन् ॥

meaning.en: He gives wisdom to a child and childishness to the wise; the Lord does all this, speaking forth the seed in the beginning.

verses.text:
अलं विज्ञापनाय स्यादाचक्षीथा यथातथम् ।
अथो मन्त्रं मन्त्रयित्वा अन्योन्येनातिहृष्टवत् ॥

meaning.en: This is enough to be reported; tell it just as it is. And then, having taken counsel together as if greatly pleased, go on.

verses.text:
गावल्गणे कुरून्गत्वा धृतराष्ट्रं महाबलम् ।
अभिवाद्योपसंगृह्य ततः पृच्छेरनामयम् ॥

meaning.en: Son of Gavalgana, go to the Kurus and to mighty Dhritarashtra; salute him, embrace his feet, and then ask after his health.

verses.text:
ब्रूयाश्चैनं त्वमासीनं कुरुभिः परिवारितम् ।
तवैव राजन्वीर्येण सुखं जीवन्ति पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: Say to him as he sits surrounded by the Kurus: "King, it is by your own strength that the Pandavas live happily.

verses.text:
तव प्रसादाद्बालास्ते प्राप्ता राज्यमरिंदम ।
राज्ये तान्स्थापयित्वाग्रे नोपेक्षीर्विनशिष्यतः ॥

meaning.en: By your favor, these boys won a kingdom, scourge of foes; having set them in the kingdom, do not now overlook them as they are about to be ruined.

verses.text:
सर्वमप्येतदेकस्य नालं संजय कस्यचित् ।
तात संहत्य जीवामो मा द्विषद्भ्यो वशं गमः ॥

meaning.en: All this wealth is not enough for one man alone, Sanjaya. Dear friend, let us live together and not fall into the power of our enemies."

verses.text:
तथा भीष्मं शांतनवं भारतानां पितामहम् ।
शिरसाभिवदेथास्त्वं मम नाम प्रकीर्तयन् ॥

meaning.en: Likewise bow your head to Bhishma, son of Shantanu, grandsire of the Bharatas, speaking my name.

verses.text:
अभिवाद्य च वक्तव्यस्ततोऽस्माकं पितामहः ।
भवता शंतनोर्वंशो निमग्नः पुनरुद्धृतः ॥

meaning.en: Having saluted him, say to our grandfather: "You raised up again the house of Shantanu when it had sunk.

verses.text:
स त्वं कुरु तथा तात स्वमतेन पितामह ।
यथा जीवन्ति ते पौत्राः प्रीतिमन्तः परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: So act, dear grandfather, by your own judgment, so that your grandsons live fondly with one another."

verses.text:
तथैव विदुरं ब्रूयाः कुरूणां मन्त्रधारिणम् ।
अयुद्धं सौम्य भाषस्व हितकामो युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: In the same way speak to Vidura, who holds the counsel of the Kurus: "Gentle friend, speak for peace, with no war; Yudhishthira wishes your good."

verses.text:
अथो सुयोधनं ब्रूया राजपुत्रममर्षणम् ।
मध्ये कुरूणामासीनमनुनीय पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Then speak to Suyodhana, the prince, so easily angered, as he sits among the Kurus, soothing him again and again:

verses.text:
अपश्यन्मामुपेक्षन्तं कृष्णामेकां सभागताम् ।
तद्दुःखमतितिक्षाम मा वधीष्म कुरूनिति ॥

meaning.en: "You saw me look away while Krishna alone stood in the assembly; we bore that grief, thinking, 'Let us not kill the Kurus.'

verses.text:
एवं पूर्वापरान्क्लेशानतितिक्षन्त पाण्डवाः ।
यथा बलीयसः सन्तस्तत्सर्वं कुरवो विदुः ॥

meaning.en: So the Pandavas have borne every earlier and later affliction, though they are stronger; all this the Kurus know.

verses.text:
यन्नः प्राव्राजयः सौम्य अजिनैः प्रतिवासितान् ।
तद्दुःखमतितिक्षाम मा वधीष्म कुरूनिति ॥

meaning.en: That you sent us into exile, gentle one, clothed in deerskins, we bore that grief too, thinking, 'Let us not kill the Kurus.'

verses.text:
यत्तत्सभायामाक्रम्य कृष्णां केशेष्वधर्षयत् ।
दुःशासनस्तेऽनुमते तच्चास्माभिरुपेक्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: When in the assembly Duhshasana, with your consent, seized Krishna and dragged her by the hair, we ignored even that.

verses.text:
यथोचितं स्वकं भागं लभेमहि परंतप ।
निवर्तय परद्रव्ये बुद्धिं गृद्धां नरर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Scourge of foes, let us receive our own rightful share; bull among men, turn your mind back from greed for another's wealth.

verses.text:
शान्तिरेवं भवेद्राजन्प्रीतिश्चैव परस्परम् ।
राज्यैकदेशमपि नः प्रयच्छ शममिच्छताम् ॥

meaning.en: In this way, king, there may be peace and mutual affection. Give us even one portion of the kingdom, for we wish for peace.

verses.text:
कुशस्थलं वृकस्थलमासन्दी वारणावतम् ।
अवसानं भवेदत्र किंचिदेव तु पञ्चमम् ॥

meaning.en: Kushasthala, Vrikasthala, Asandi, Varanavata, and for the last one any single village whatever.

verses.text:
भ्रातॄणां देहि पञ्चानां ग्रामान्पञ्च सुयोधन ।
शान्तिर्नोऽस्तु महाप्राज्ञ ज्ञातिभिः सह संजय ॥

meaning.en: Give five villages to my five brothers, Suyodhana. Let there be peace for us with our kinsmen, Sanjaya, O very wise one."

verses.text:
भ्राता भ्रातरमन्वेतु पिता पुत्रेण युज्यताम् ।
स्मयमानाः समायान्तु पाञ्चालाः कुरुभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: Let brother be reunited with brother, let father be joined with son; let the Panchalas come smiling together with the Kurus.

verses.text:
अक्षतान्कुरुपाञ्चालान्पश्येम इति कामये ।
सर्वे सुमनसस्तात शाम्याम भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: I long to see the Kurus and Panchalas unharmed. Let all of us, dear friend, be at peace with glad hearts, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
अलमेव शमायास्मि तथा युद्धाय संजय ।
धर्मार्थयोरलं चाहं मृदवे दारुणाय च ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, I am equal to peace and equally to war; I am equal to both dharma and wealth, to being gentle and to being fierce.
